natural_wadis.rule: Incised drainage channels lack topological bridging unless intersecting formal bridge overpasses; edges severed across banks.

grade_separated_expressways.rule: Access restricted strictly to grade-separated pedestrian footbridges and designated intersection signals.

circuity_metrics.extreme_outliers_explanation: Circuity ratios up to 70.97 reflect unbridged wadi cuts separating adjacent centroids.
